answer: The wander assignment is published and jetty records each panel. The grading quorum of 3 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the forge graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3418 identities would post 3099 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
